title_english: The Wisdom of the Village Elder Woman
description: Traditional Tai wisdom story documented in Pacific Linguistics 565 (p. 384, 410), demonstrating how an unassuming elder grandmother solved a boundary conflict between neighboring clans using ancient customary law and gentle words.

full_translation: An elder grandmother lived peacefully in a small stilt house at the edge of the village. Two young hotheaded farmers engaged in a bitter quarrel over the boundary dike of their rice paddies. They brought their grievance before the grandmother, asking her to declare who was the owner. The wise grandmother smiled gently: 'The earth remains steadfast forever, but mortal men pass away like morning dew.' Overcome with shame and understanding, the two youths reconciled and clasped hands in brotherhood. The counsel of our elders is like healing nectar that preserves communal harmony.
title: The Wisdom of the Village Elder Woman
